name: hono-routing
title: 荣耀路由和中间件
description: Build type-safe APIs with Hono - fast, lightweight routing for Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, and Node.js. Set up routing patterns, middleware composition, request validation (Zod/Valibot/Typia/ArkType), RPC client/server with full type inference, and error handling with HTTPException.
